description:
FILED s412 (Fable) from the Phase B1 measurement (docs/plan-one-compiler-s411.md; tools/sub-call-census.pl --sample 12).

MEASURED: Pl::Parser2::_premerge_include_prototypes 13.10 s INCLUSIVE of the 50 s sample (Pl::Parser::parse 37 calls / 11.77 s; _extract_module_prototypes 30 calls / 3.81 s â the rest is _extract_file_prototypes for `require './test.pl'`).  The plan's '_process_element 11.2 s incl. (embedded blocks + the 12 classes)' was THIS: after B1 (analysis parses compile no blocks) every one of the 162 remaining PCL_E2_RAW_CENSUS decl:no-hook events over the corpus is under Pl::Parser::_extract_module_prototypes, and _fallback_stmt_capture (the seam) is only 0.92 s / 237 calls.

WHAT IT DOES: Pl::Parser->new(collect_prototypes_only => 1)->parse($doc) â v1's entire statement pipeline (every statement processed, every expression PExpr-parsed AND ExprToCL-generated, every block compiled; _emit a no-op) over the module, transitively for each nested `use`, once per pl2cl PROCESS (state $cache).  For perl-tests the 3 000-line t/test.pl is fully v1-compiled on every transpile.

WHAT IS CONSUMED (_merge_module_prototypes, Parser.pm): $module_env->prototypes (name â {has_block_arg, is_proto, params, min_params, â¦}) and export_names (/ qw() lists, already a regex scan).  Nothing else of the walk's work survives.

FIX SHAPE: a facts-only walk over the module's PPI document â PPI::Statement::Sub (name + prototype / signature â the same add_prototype record _process_sub_statement builds; sub NAME () {â¦} = zero-arg term), `use constant NAME => â¦` / `use constant { â¦ }` (zero-arg terms), nested PPI::Statement::Include (recurse, same skip lists), the  scan; INSIDE BEGIN/blocks too (perl-tests' test.pl declares subs at top level; shims too).  Bars: corpus-diff IDENTICAL over perl-tests, tools/emission-ab.pl over lib/**/*.pm SAME, full sweep TOTAL/LOST/DROPS unchanged, companion --quick once (both populations reach modules), gate; then the whole-corpus compile time (55 s at s412) â the census says up to ~25 % is on the table.  Ask first WHICH prototype registrations the walk performs that a Sub/Include/constant scan would miss (grep add_prototype in Parser.pm: glob installs `*name = sub () {â¦}`, `_register_*` in _process_use_*, â¦) â measure by diffing the two envs' prototypes over every module the corpus loads before switching.

WHY IT MATTERS STRUCTURALLY: it is the LAST live entry into v1's file-level parse() (E4.1 step 3 kept parse() only for this); with a facts walk, parse() and the collect_prototypes_only mode die, and PExpr never again runs with a hook-less parser from Parser2 (the no-hook branch of Pl::Parser::embed_block is then reachable only from v1's own constant/default compiles).

DONE s412 (Fable), commit f5bb860: Pl::Parser::collect_prototypes (facts walk) + the three shared head helpers; v1 parse()/_assemble_output/_insert_variable_forward_declarations deleted; PCL_PROTO_ORACLE oracle identical over 95 modules; compile time as the sweep runs it 81 -> 64 s (-21 %).  See docs/session-log.md s412 + DECIDED s412.
